functions.evidence: Terminated input append with no lowercasing/history/callback. Appends current byte, count then fresh terminator pointer; re-reads limit/count and advances input before rotating when full. CR/LF rotates without append. Every iteration fetches input anew; count/array/data aliases remain visible.
